info.title: SnapRequest API
info.description: Execute requests, run flows and collections, browse history and edit collections. See docs/SERVER.md.

200.description: `{ key, file }`: the folder's `folder.toml` as JSON (defaults when absent)

requestBody.description: `folder.toml` as JSON (`{}` for a plain folder)

200.description: Saved; the folder is created if needed

post.summary: Moves, renames or reorders a request, folder or flow.

put.summary: Like `snapreq secret set`: stores a secret value in the collection's `.secrets/` directory.

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: An environment name, or `shared` for every environment

get.summary:
The variables a request sees, with the scope each comes from (for highlighting
placeholders in the UI).

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Request (or flow) key whose scopes are listed; absent lists collection-level ones.

200.description: `{ variables: [{ name, value, secret, has_value, scope }] }`; secret values are never returned

parameters.name: failed
parameters.description: `true`: only failures without a response; `false`: only responses.

200.description: Summary with stored request and response
The exchange (`response` or `error`), stored in history

post.summary: `POST /api/v1/runs`: runs to completion, stores the result and returns its summary.

200.description: The run document plus its stored `id`
The report as a file download (like `snapreq run --report`)

capture_wire.description:
Record the raw bytes sent and received (a `wire` trace event), whatever the
request's own settings say.

collection.description: Or a collection request: collection id and request key.

file.description:
With `collection` and `key`: unsaved contents of the request file (as JSON), sent
instead of the saved file, with the same inheritance and variables. Not written.

request.description: A complete request (the core JSON model).

HistorySummary.description: A row of the history list (without the large JSON columns).

JsonDocument.description: A JSON document; its shape is described in `docs/SERVER.md`.

from.description: Key of the item to move.

name.description: New name (file or directory name without extension); absent keeps the name.

oneOf.description:
Position among the destination's items (written to its `order`); absent keeps
the order rules as they are. Not used for flows.

to.description: Key of the destination folder; `""` is the collection root.

Place.description: Where a moved item goes in its folder's order.

before.description: The sibling (by name) to put the item before; absent puts it last.

capture_wire.description: Record the raw bytes of every exchange (`wire` trace events in the stored report).

from_step.description:
Flows only: the first step to run (1-based). With `resume`, the captured values of the
earlier steps come from that run.

insecure.description: Skip TLS certificate verification for every request (`snapreq run -k`).

resume.description:
Flows only: the id of an earlier run of this flow whose state before `from_step` to
start from (kept in memory for an hour; never stored or returned).

target.description: A flow or folder key; absent runs every request of the collection.

timeout_ms.description: Time limit per request in milliseconds, `0` for none (`snapreq run -t`).

to_step.description: Flows only: the last step to run.

tags.name: collections
tags.description: Collections, requests, flows and environments in the workspace
